author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube

The Magic of Disney Animation Imagineering Easter Egg Tour
The Magic of Disney Animation at Disney's Hollywood Studios is filled with experiences that help further the story of the short "Once Upon a Studio" with wonderful spaces that show what the characters are up to after jumping out of their portraits. Inspired by the Walt Disney Animation Studios, this new space is full of activities, interactive elements, and Easter eggs with a lot of favorite characters!

🎥 *Behind-the-Scenes with Imagineers*
WED Walks and WED Rides allows you to learn more about our Disney attractions and experiences with the Imagineers who brought them to life!
